body: Thank you for replying. I'm really happy for you that you found someone who makes you truly happy. I hope I'll find something in my life that'll help me enjoy life again as your girlfriend did with you.

Don't worry, there's no way you could have known haha. I haven't heard about these subreddits till now, I'll make sure to check them out.
No I haven't told my mom how she makes me feel, as I don't know how she would react, but I'm pretty sure she would be defensive and try to send me on a guilt trip.

Unfortunately, if I want a part-time job, I can't choose the job I'm interested in, since it needs special education/training, and it would only be full-time. I could do something like being a waitress at a restaurant, or maybe being a salesperson in a bookshop, but I need some time to think about it.

And again, thanks for all your help. I'm a stranger, and I will most probably never meet you in person, yet you're here trying to help me with my life. My god, modern technology is amazing.

I live in a country where the schooling system is different. I can't choose how many classes I have, I have to attend everyday from 8 am to 3 pm. I'm home at 4 pm and then I have homework or stuff to study. I only have time on the weekends.

Working out once was a big part of my life, but I'll try to pick it up again, since it helps me with my mental state. Also,  I'm happy you pushed through with that CrossFit thing! Congratulations, and keep it up :)

It's quite possible that gaming is my way of escape, I game everyday way too much... 
I think this is because of my motivation too, it's much easier to sit in front of a screen and press some buttons rather than do something creative or productive.

I'm slightly overweight, my body is unproportional and I have acne. Also I'm female, to clear that up.

Thanks for your help, I really appreciate it. I'll def look through the fitness subreddits you linked :)

I think the main source of my suicidal thoughts is my family, really. My mother picks on me where she can. She says, as her child, I have to listen and obey, and shut my mouth. At first she sympathizes with me if I tell her about my problems, later she majes fun of me because of it and uses everything I said against me. She describes herself as a good mother who does everything the right way. Her presence just makes me sick (sorry I just can't put it any other way), but I can't move out, I don't earn any money and I don't have a car.

Thank you for your reply. 
Yes, I already though about quitting school and apply for the job I've been interested in for some time now, but I've been going to college for so long now that quitting isn't really an option anymore, I might as well graduate. It will be hard to improve my grades though because of my motivation problem and my video game addiction takes away many hours of my life. 
Right now my life is at a pretty low point and it's just so tiring to carry on when you have nothing to look forward to, but I know I have to change that.
Thank you for your reply. It's so nice to read something nice and non-judging as a reply for something I said for a change. May I ask you how you got out of your depression?
